name: dex_token_trade_klines
description: Get trade-page token klines for exchange-style dashboards. Defaults to 15-minute recent candles and can be used for live trade panels.

token.description: Token symbol, name, or CoinGecko-style asset identifier such as BTC, ETH, SOL, or bitcoin.

asset_id.description: CoinGecko asset identifier when already known, such as bitcoin or ethereum.

vs_currency.description: Quote currency for the klines. Defaults to usd.

interval.description: Kline interval. Supported values: 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d. Defaults to 15m.

limit.description: Maximum number of candles to return. Defaults to 32 and must be 100 or less.

days.description: Recent data range in days. Defaults to 1.
